manifest.name: Abuse Goblin
manifest.summary: Hit the Goblin Tinkerer with any weapon to lower his reforge prices.

manifest.name: Atmospheric Torches
manifest.summary: This mod simply adds an orange tint to normal torches and tiki torches, with their placed tiles and biome torches getting a slight flicker for atmosphere.

manifest.name: Begone, Evil! (Disable Evil Biome Spread)
manifest.summary: Disables natural Corruption, Crimson and Hallow biome spread by default, with a per-world /spread toggle.

manifest.name: Bestiary Displays
manifest.summary: Hologram Projectors that show any unlocked Bestiary creature as an animated, configurable hologram.

manifest.name: Better Reforge
manifest.summary: Replaces the traditional Goblin Tinkerer interface with a new system that allows you to browse and select item prefixes directly.

manifest.name: Boss Checklist
manifest.summary: A Boss Log book with every boss, mini-boss and event: progress checklist, spawn items and recipes, loot and collectibles, fight records, despawn messages and a boss radar.

manifest.name: ChestPeek
manifest.summary: Point at any container (chest, piggy bank, safe, forge, void vault) to see what is inside.

manifest.name: Colored Damage Types
manifest.summary: Damage numbers and tooltips in the color of the weapon's class: melee, ranged, magic, summon, sentry, throwing and modded classes.

manifest.name: Consolaria Mobile
manifest.summary: Tons of exclusive content from the legacy and old-gen versions, reworked and rebalanced for modern Terraria.

manifest.name: Coyote Frames
manifest.summary: Mod that allows player to use Coyote frames that are presented in many other games.

authors.name: Gorffy, Ink of the Eternity, Litos the Litium

manifest.name: Dev Tools
manifest.summary: 一个直观的工具界面：难度切换、实体清除、碰撞箱、天气与时间、相机与拍照模式、调试信息。

manifest.name: Directional Swings
manifest.summary: Melee swords swing toward where you aim, and the hitbox follows the blade.

manifest.name: Don't Starve inspired NPC portraits
manifest.author: Fanec
manifest.description: Don't Starve inspired NPC portraits — port Bunny Loader.
manifest.notes: Original resource pack by Fanec. Texture assets retained with their original relative paths under content/Images.

manifest.name: Flat Seed
manifest.summary: A secret seed for a world so flat you can run without fear of tripping into a hole: type "flat" when creating a world. Caves, biomes, structures and the floating islands stay as usual.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: Uma seed secreta para um mundo tão plano que dá para correr sem medo de cair num buraco: digite "plano" ou "flat" ao criar um mundo. Cavernas, biomas, estruturas e as ilhas flutuantes continuam normais.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: Una semilla secreta para un mundo tan plano que puedes correr sin miedo a caer en un agujero: escribe "plano" o "flat" al crear un mundo. Las cuevas, los biomas, las estructuras y las islas flotantes siguen como siempre.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: Секретный сид для мира настолько плоского, что можно бежать, не боясь провалиться в яму: введите «плоский» или «flat» при создании мира. Пещеры, биомы, постройки и парящие острова остаются как обычно.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 一个平到可以放心狂奔、不怕掉进坑里的世界秘密种子：创建世界时输入「平坦」或「flat」。洞穴、生物群系、建筑和浮空岛照常保留。
localizedSummaries.vi-VN: Một hạt giống bí mật cho thế giới phẳng đến mức bạn có thể chạy mà không sợ rơi xuống hố: gõ "phẳng" hoặc "flat" khi tạo thế giới. Hang động, quần xã, công trình và đảo bay vẫn như bình thường.
localizedSummaries.th-TH: ซีดลับสำหรับโลกที่แบนจนวิ่งได้โดยไม่ต้องกลัวตกหลุม: พิมพ์ "แบน" หรือ "flat" ตอนสร้างโลก ถ้ำ ไบโอม สิ่งก่อสร้าง และเกาะลอยฟ้ายังคงเหมือนเดิม

manifest.name: Fonte Ale and Wenches
manifest.author: Nate Piekos (Blambot)
manifest.summary: Letra de taverna medieval, desenhada à mão

manifest.name: Fonte Comic Neue
manifest.summary: Troca as fontes do jogo pela Comic Neue, nítida em qualquer tela

manifest.name: Fonte Pescadero
manifest.author: Microsoft

manifest.name: Fonte Ringbearer
manifest.author: Pete Klassen

manifest.name: Gravitation Don't Flip the Screen
manifest.summary: This mod makes the gravity inversion effect not flip your screen, only the player flips.

manifest.name: Improved Movement
manifest.summary: Your head follows the cursor, your body leans as you move, and slimes, zombies and critters lean too.

manifest.name: Item Display Base
manifest.summary: A Display Base to show off any item, with glitter, outline and light effects. Made from marble or granite.

manifest.name: Legendary Difficulty
manifest.summary: 为游戏添加自定义世界难度（原版只有普通/专家/大师/旅行难度），并加入传奇难度。.

manifest.name: Lights And Shadows
manifest.summary: Sunlight, moonlight, shadow rays and bloom over the world, ported from the tModLoader mod and rebuilt to run on phones.

manifest.name: Loot Beams
manifest.summary: Borderlands-style light beams and glows in each dropped item's rarity color, with beam styles, glow and configurable lists.

manifest.name: Minecraft Paintings
manifest.summary: Minecraft Paintings is a small-scale aesthetic content mod that adds all 30 paintings featured in Minecraft, manually recreated to include less noise and tile dimensions fitting Terraria paintings.

manifest.name: Minishark Turbo
manifest.summary: A Minishark vira uma metralhadora.

manifest.name: Mita NPC
manifest.summary: Four MiSide town NPCs with voiced dialogue, shops, weapons, pets and permanent combat manuals.

manifest.name: No Useless Pickups
manifest.summary: Consumable pickups (life hearts, mana stars, and Nebula boosters) can no longer be picked up if they are not needed.

manifest.name: NPC Fall Damage
manifest.summary: This mod allows NPCs to take fall damage. Pretty self explanatory. This bonus also applies to bosses.

manifest.name: NPC Unlock Announcer
manifest.summary: An RPG-style banner announces every Town NPC and town pet that moves into your world.

manifest.name: Overhealth
manifest.summary: Healing past full health becomes temporary Overhealth that absorbs damage and slowly decays.

manifest.name: Quality of Bunny
manifest.summary: Quality-of-life tweaks, every one a toggle in Mod Configuration.

manifest.name: Resized Frames
manifest.summary: Items placed in frames will be drawn at their actual size

manifest.name: Shared Inventory
manifest.summary: On multiplayer, the host's inventory, armor, pets and life/mana are shared with everyone.

manifest.name: Teleport Keeper
manifest.summary: Create teleports with a name and a biome icon, organize them in a list with search, favorites and filters, and travel to them from the map. When you die, a way back that is only yours.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: Crie teleportes com nome e ícone do bioma, organize-os numa lista com busca, favoritos e filtros, e viaje até eles pelo mapa. Ao morrer, um ponto de volta só seu.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: Crea teletransportes con nombre e icono del bioma, organízalos en una lista con búsqueda, favoritos y filtros, y viaja hasta ellos desde el mapa. Al morir, un punto de regreso solo tuyo.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: Создавайте телепорты с названием и значком биома, держите их в списке с поиском, избранным и фильтрами и перемещайтесь к ним через карту. После смерти — точка возврата только для вас.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 创建带名称和生物群系图标的传送点，在支持搜索、收藏和筛选的列表中管理它们，并通过地图传送过去。死亡后，还有一个只属于你的返回点。
localizedSummaries.vi-VN: Tạo điểm dịch chuyển có tên và biểu tượng quần xã, sắp xếp trong danh sách có tìm kiếm, yêu thích và bộ lọc, rồi đi đến chúng từ bản đồ. Khi chết, có một điểm quay lại chỉ của riêng bạn.
localizedSummaries.th-TH: สร้างจุดวาร์ปพร้อมชื่อและไอคอนไบโอม จัดเก็บในรายการที่มีการค้นหา รายการโปรด และตัวกรอง แล้วเดินทางไปจากแผนที่ เมื่อตาย จะมีจุดกลับที่เป็นของคุณคนเดียว

manifest.name: Templo Pirâmide

manifest.summary: Uma pirâmide Lihzahrd com andares distantes, câmaras e um grande salão para o Golem.

manifest.name: Terrarchitect
manifest.summary: Terrarchitect is a furniture / build mod that adds a wide variety of custom-made, high-quality decorational items and blocks to Terraria! It also aims to make some previously ubobtainable or unplacable vanilla items available.

manifest.name: Terraria Tethers
manifest.summary: Players are tied together by a rope and have to cooperate.

manifest.name: Tooltip Icon
manifest.summary: Adds a small icon to the left of each item tooltip line: damage, speed, defense, tool power, potions, prefixes and more.

manifest.name: Touhou Pets
manifest.summary: Adventure with cute partners: 19 Touhou characters as pets, dropped by the bosses. They animate, react to the world and talk to you and to each other.

manifest.name: Vein Miner
manifest.summary: Break one ore with your pickaxe and the whole vein comes with it. Add any block with /vein add.

manifest.summary: Shows the held item on your character: swords at the waist, weapons on the back, bows, books and staves in their own poses, and combat poses after attacking.
